storage: git-versioned artifacts under datacore/gridvision/ — WHOLE-FILE REBUILD per extract re-run. tx_grid_registry.json (3.4KB aggregate — line-km + circuit-km per voltage class, substation/plant counts, gate-1 comparison; feature-level OSM data intentionally NOT committed — the TX pilot map layer already carries geometry as PMTiles). tx_county_ba.json (254 TX counties -> retail BA set from EIA-861 2024, scripts/grid_county_ba.py — the EIA-930 join key; state-preferred BA codes, NO primary BA fabricated for the 80 multi-BA counties until a polygon arbiter lands). tx_ba_capacity.json (scripts/grid_ba_capacity.py — per-county + per-BA circuit-km via segment-midpoint point-in-polygon over Census county boundaries; multi-BA county km pooled AMBIGUOUS by BA set, never split by invented ratio; conservation invariant vs the registry test-enforced).
written_by: scripts/grid_capacity_tx.py (Python, session-run on a fresh Geofabrik extract; never on Railway — the 709MB PBF download + osmium filter run in the session container per scripts/build_power_tiles.sh)
source: OpenStreetMap via Geofabrik north-america/us/texas-latest extract (first run 2026-07-07), filtered to power=line/minor_line/cable/substation/plant with osmium
license: ODbL 1.0 — the registry is a derivative database of OSM and stays ODbL; attribution '(c) OpenStreetMap contributors' carried in the artifact provenance and required on any surface that shows these numbers (see research/grid_vision_products.md license boundary: indices computed ACROSS databases are produced works; this registry itself is not)

field_map.lines/minor_lines/cables: ways, km (haversine along way), circuit_km_by_class (345kV+/230kV/100-229kV/69-99kV/<69kV/unknown), voltage_census_top20_km (exact volts), unknown_voltage {ways,km,share_of_km}, multi_voltage_ways, ways_with_circuits_tag, unparseable_voltage_parts
field_map.gate1: reference + criteria_prestated (verbatim, dated) + computed + per-check booleans + verdict — the checks are recomputable from computed values (test-enforced, verdict cannot drift from data)
field_map.tx_county_ba counties.<name>: bas[] (EIA-930-joinable codes: ERCO/SWPP/MISO/EPE/PNM), multi_ba flag, serving_utilities count — county RETAIL BA per EIA-861, not grid topology (a transmission asset in an SWPP-retail county can be an ERCOT asset; stated in provenance)
field_map.tx_ba_capacity: per_county_circuit_km (254 counties x voltage class), ba_exclusive_circuit_km (single-BA counties only), ba_ambiguous_circuit_km (keyed by BA set e.g. 'ERCO|SWPP'), out_of_state/unknown_county counted never dropped, conservation block (registry-vs-distributed by class, recomputable), kv345_ambiguous_share

confidence_model: GRID VISION A1 gate-1 (DATA layer): registry plausibility vs published ERCOT ratings, criteria PRE-STATED in the script header before the comparison ran (REASONING STANDARD #10). First run 2026-07-07: PASS on all three checks — 104,928 circuit-km >=69kV (118.5% of the ERCOT-region lower-bound anchor, sensible for a whole-state extract), unknown-voltage share 3.8%, 345kV+ 31,559 circuit-km. KNOWN DEFINITIONAL CAVEAT (stated, not hidden): the ERCOT reference may count route-miles or circuit-miles — our circuit-km convention (multi-voltage way = 1 circuit per voltage; circuits=N multiplies) can differ from theirs by the double-circuit share; gate-2 work refines against EIA/HIFLD per-line data before the stress index is trusted. HYPOTHESES (gate-locked, priors in research/grid_vision_products.md A1): capacity registry x EIA-930 demand x weather -> grid-stress index; nothing trades or sells until ladder gates pass.
geo_fields: aggregate registry only — no coordinates in this artifact; feature geometry lives in the TX pilot PMTiles layer (client/public/tiles/power_tx.pmtiles) and the session-run extract
entity_key: voltage class (aggregate registry; per-feature IDs arrive with Phase B per the products-plan spec)
cadence: session-run re-build on Geofabrik extract refresh (extract updates daily; re-run when the stress-index work needs fresher topology or when Phase B ships corrections)
